summary: Verified spec 2026-07-30: admin 'Valider' now bypasses payment-existence check while automated sources still enforce it. Backend: all 5 pytest cases in test_activation_guard.py pass (unknown source refused, automated sources still refused without payment, admin_validate succeeds without payment/activation record, payment-row-exists path still works, admin_manual still works). Frontend E2E: created a fresh user (tst_adm_addf5782) with a pending manual activation and ZERO db.payments row; logged in as admin, clicked Valider; native dialog 'Succès ✅ Opération réussie' fired, row disappeared from En attente (16→15), Activées incremented (3→4), and DB confirms user.status='active', max_level=1 with 0 payments. Regression paths (reject, hacker_input, whitelisted external without payment) all still refuse.
critical_code_review_comments: matrix.py::activate_level: the ALLOWED_SOURCES set docstring still lists 'admin_validate' under PAID sources needing an external payment row — the header comment is slightly stale vs the actual _PAID_EXTERNAL set (which correctly excludes admin_validate). Consider updating the docstring section labels to match the runtime enforcement.

Consider adding an admin audit log entry when admin_validate is used without any matching payment/activation row so the bypass path is traceable for compliance (currently the row exists in db.activations because /activations/request created it, so this is minor).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login + admin panel + Valider dialog + DB persistence + counters update)

seed_data_creation: Created user tst_adm_addf5782 (email tst_adm_addf5782@example.com) with a pending manual activation and NO payment record; then validated via admin UI. User is now active max_level=1. Safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reproduce a pending activation without a payment row: register user (requires password_confirm field), POST /api/auth/confirm-password to get confirm_token, then POST /api/activations/request {level:1, payment_method:'manual'} with header X-Password-Confirm=<confirm_token>. Do NOT touch db.payments. Then admin can click Valider and it must succeed.
rca of the issue: Removed 'admin_validate' from _PAID_EXTERNAL guard set in matrix.py::activate_level (lines ~294-295). Guard now only applies to soleaspay/ashtecpay/sendavapay/gateway_return/manual_reprocess. Admin's Valider click on an existing db.activations row is treated as authoritative — the admin has already reconciled the payment on Wave/MTN/Moov gateway. Fully verified via pytest + E2E UI test with a zero-payment user.
